title: The pup at seven
logline: The pup on the flats at seven, mid-scuttle, the two-one prints, a channel jumped. The dog page of the year. Nobody else.

panels.composition: The mudflats at low tide with a small three-legged dog in mid-jump over a channel, the two-one prints behind him, the chimney far across the bay.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, tidal mudflats with a small three-legged dog in mid-jump over a narrow channel, a two-one trail of prints behind, a distant chimney across the bay, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The dog page. A channel jumped.
